disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. The card is invite-only.

fuel_surcharge.summary: ICICI passes the merchant surcharge. A 1 percent waiver applies at all petrol pumps on this card. GST on surcharge is not reversed on off-us transactions.

base_earn.summary: Other spends outside Amazon earn 1 percent, credited to Amazon Pay balance. Marketing describes earnings as unlimited.

accelerated.summary: Amazon.in earns 5 percent for Prime members and 3 percent for non-Prime members. More than 100 Amazon Pay partner merchants earn 2 percent via Login and Pay with Amazon.

conditions.summary: The 5 percent and 3 percent rates apply on Amazon.in and depend on Prime membership.

upi.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

redemption.summary: Earnings credit to Amazon Pay balance after the billing cycle and appear as a gift card on Amazon within about 2 working days. This is not a generic ICICI catalogue.

expiry.summary: Marketing states that Amazon Pay earnings never expire.
